name: Ultaar
description: Ultaar was a planet in the Mid Rim Bortele sector, covered in jungles of towering giant blossoms that covered the world with a thick scent. Ultaar was home to the four-armed sentient species known as the Ultaarian Greenback. During the Galactic Civil War, Ultaar became host to a small Rebel Alliance presence, which was wiped out in 0 ABY by cyborg bounty hunter Beilert Valance.
